description: SmartPay offers a unified payments + invoicing platform for Indian SMBs.

faqs.a: We provide payments, invoicing and reconciliation in one dashboard.

faqs.q: do you have a free tier
faqs.a: Yes — a limited free tier up to 100 transactions per month.
Small and medium businesses, retail stores, and online sellers in India.
We offer Free, Standard (monthly fee + per-transaction), and Enterprise plans.

pricing.details: Up to 100 transactions / month, basic dashboard
